adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the database update is explicitly scoped to a single Booking record (`prisma.booking.update({ where: { id: bookingId }, ... })`), so no sibling bookings would get new Attendee rows. The handler also constructs a `CalendarEvent` that includes `recurringEvent: parseRecurringEvent(booking.eventType?.recurringEvent)` before calling `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`, but the diff does not show that this calendar update will actually apply to an entire recurring series (vs. just the instance). Therefore the claimed “external calendar shows on every occurrence” part isn’t verifiable from the diff, but the recurring-series consistency concern is a concrete, diff-grounded edge case worth addressing.
